bridgeAdapterPatches: Generation isolation for stale response detection
connectE2EE registers only devices without a server identity and waits for the encrypted socket

loginHelper.reason: fbchat-v2 2.3.2 still pins mautrix/meta 3ed7bfa, whose Bloks interpreter crashes on Facebook's current Messenger Lite login pages (nil GetArg in bk.action.f32.Eq, missing bk.action.array.Get). mautrix-meta is vendored locally (login/meta via a replace directive) with a small Bloks patch adding bk.action.string.StartsWith/EndsWith/Contains, which v0.2609.1 still lacks but the OTP input validation uses.
